title: Q3
prompt: Where does the speaker go to clear their mind after a hectic day?
hint: Begin with 'I go hiking on ...' and include 'mountain trails'.
sample: I go hiking on mountain trails.

ja.sample: 私は山のトレイルへハイキングに行きます。
